Source: public Kaggle notebook
[`ahmedberatozer/kaggriculture-v45-first-turn-wheat-round-trip`](https://www.kaggle.com/code/ahmedberatozer/kaggriculture-v45-first-turn-wheat-round-trip).

`main.py` was reconstructed by the notebook's own `reconstruct.py` cell. Its
published SHA-256 is:

```text
2536d41ed5a00c75204b6350f1c76c54259c774cb065ba2a3a0072eedf210d94
```

The source retains Apache 2.0 notices from its upstream derivations. As of
2026-09-17 it is the project's **frozen local development base**: experiments
load it as `v45_base`, and all new changes must be separate, named variants rather
than edits to this exact file. It remains a third-party derivative, not original
user-authored code. Before any Kaggle packaging or submission, re-check the
competition rules, every retained notice, and the upstream route/replay provenance.
